A direction stops early at the field or output edge, NaN data, or speed zero or below minimumSpeed; only visited pixels join both sums. The noise N is white noise per output pixel, Philox keyed (seed, column, row). With period > 0 the window is multiplied by 0.5 * (1 + cos(2 pi (s / period - phase))); this run is static (period 0).
